title: OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.30017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake. Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task. Solutions are scored on practical measures such as speed, cost and accuracy, both on provided cases the agent could test against and on hidden cases that an engineer would expect from the task description. The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task. We highlight two findings. translated_title: OWE-Bench：一个用于衡量真实世界工程能力的长时程基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了OWE-Bench（OpenWorldEngineer-Bench），这是一个包含26个长时程工程任务的基准，这些任务由软件工程、物理工程、机器学习和科学计算领域的专家撰写。任务范围从优化内核、设计飞机，到识别引发地震的断层。每个任务都需要大量的领域知识和工程工作，模型平均每个任务消耗数亿个token。解决方案根据速度、成本和准确性等实用指标进行评分，既包括智能体可以测试的给定用例，也包括工程师从任务描述中可以预期的隐藏用例。目前表现最好的前沿模型Claude Fable 5.2得分为54.6%，平均每个任务消耗2.11亿个token。我们强调了两个发现：首先，当模型获得更多时间时，它们会使用更多的测试时计算并获得更高的分数；其次，模型在……方面的扩展方式各不相同（原文在此截断）。
tldr: OWE-Bench是一个由领域专家设计的、包含26个长时程真实工程任务（涵盖软件、物理、机器学习和科学计算）的基准，用于评估AI模型的实际工程能力，目前最佳前沿模型得分仅为54.6%。
en_tdlr: OWE-Bench is a benchmark of 26 expert-written long-horizon real-world engineering tasks spanning software, physics, machine learning, and scientific computing, on which the best frontier model achieves only 54.6%.
